rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for establishing an institution or organization.

example.english: The three of us found this social welfare organization together.
example.traditional: 呢間社福機構係我哋三個一齊成立嘅。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 se5 fuk1 gei1 kau3 hai6 ngo5 dei6 saam1 go3 jat1 cai4 sing4 lap6 ge3

rows.note: Use this when stressing that someone personally founded or started the institution.

example.traditional: 呢間學校係我親自創辦嘅。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 hok6 haau6 hai6 ngo5 can1 zi6 cong3 baan6 ge3

rows.note: Use this especially for starting a school, course, service, or business operation.

example.english: We found a Cantonese evening course last month.
example.traditional: 我哋上個月開辦咗夜間廣東話班。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 soeng6 go3 jyut6 hoi1 baan6 zo2 je6 gaan1 gwong2 dung1 waa2 baan1
